about: I’m a computer science student from Pennsylvania with an interest in technology, photography, and exploring new places.
I’m pursuing a B.S. in Computer Science at Shippensburg University, with an expected graduation in May 2030. I enjoy building websites, trying ideas, and learning through hands-on work.
My experience includes mobile application testing, live event AV support, seasonal work, guest services, and facilities support. I also volunteer at events and help with park and trail conservation.

projects.name: StudentSquare
projects.summary: A college marketplace project that brings student listings, housing, and campus resources into one place. The current prototype uses sample data to explore how students could buy, sell, and connect.

projects.name: Rocky Digital Media
projects.summary: My photography and digital media project. I photograph fursuit portraits, convention moments, and groups, alongside the places and everyday details that catch my eye.

projects.name: rocksishungry
projects.summary: A character-led home for Rocky’s social profiles and contact links. It brings my online creative presence together in a simple, playful page. The earlier rocks.dog repository belongs to the same website’s history.

projects.name: My Personal Portfolio
projects.summary: A single-page portfolio bringing together my education, technical work, and photography. Built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
